title: LLM-based Hardware Development with Hierarchical IRs and End-to-End Multi-Agent Workflow
abstract: arXiv:2608.30659v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software development, but their use in complex hardware design remains limited. This gap stems from both the scarcity of public hardware training data and the fundamentally different methodologies used in hardware design. In particular, applying LLMs to hardware requires more than direct RTL generation: the model must understand module boundaries, inter-module connections, and verification requirements. In this paper, we present an LLM-based hardware development framework with hierarchical intermediate representations (IRs) and an end-to-end multi-agent workflow. The core idea is to provide an abstraction of hardware design to LLMs through two structured IRs: Architectural Sketch, which captures module topology and interconnection, and Operational Specification, which defines per-module functionality and interfaces. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的硬件开发：分层中间表示与端到端多智能体工作流
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在软件开发中的应用日益增多，但其在复杂硬件设计中的应用仍然有限。这一差距源于公开硬件训练数据的稀缺，以及硬件设计所采用的截然不同的方法论。特别是，将LLM应用于硬件设计不仅仅是直接生成RTL代码：模型必须理解模块边界、模块间连接以及验证需求。在本文中，我们提出了一个基于LLM的硬件开发框架，该框架采用分层中间表示（IRs）和端到端的多智能体工作流。其核心思想是通过两种结构化中间表示为LLM提供硬件设计的抽象：架构草图，用于捕获模块拓扑结构和互连关系；操作规范，用于定义每个模块的功能和接口。我们的框架利用这些IRs将复杂设计分解为子……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于大语言模型的硬件开发框架，通过“架构草图”和“操作规范”两种分层中间表示及端到端多智能体工作流，使LLM能够理解模块拓扑、接口与验证需求，从而应对复杂硬件设计任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-based hardware development framework that leverages two hierarchical intermediate representations (Architectural Sketch and Operational Specification) and an end-to-end multi-agent workflow, enabling LLMs to handle complex hardware designs by understanding module topology, interfaces, and verification requirements.
